connector.name: Nordic Data by nordicdata.cloud
connector.registryDescription: Global B2B intelligence for AI agents: 35M+ companies, 1.6M sanctions, KYB pack. 78 tools.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.nordicdata.cloud over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace cloud.nordicdata, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
